question: What alternative offering form is indicated for the thumbs using oṃ and krāṃ followed by an etcetera clause?
premises: The formula offers oṃ krāṃ to the thumbs with namaḥ.
The token iti+ādinā signals a formula beginning thus and continuing.
The particle vā marks this as an alternative option.
inference: Verse 1302 gives the offering oṃ krāṃ to the thumbs, obeisance, and indicates by iti+ādinā vā an alternative or continued form beginning thus.
uncertainties: The full extension after iti+ādinā is not shown in this verse.
plain_english: Oṃ krāṃ to the thumbs, obeisance; or (the formula) beginning thus, and so on.
